coverage: Queued mixed +/- clicks compose and retain identical native Inventory and synthetic InventoryView references.
No close/open calls or synthetic held-cursor-item changes from number buttons.
Queued Save and Review consume the latest adjusted value.
Invalid typed values retain the most recently adjusted price and quantity.
Quantity lower and stock upper bounds retain the same window.
Back and Cancel invalidate queued navigation, edits, Save and Review; stale callbacks cannot revive cancelled drafts or buy.
Duplicate final confirmations make one exact debit and credit and deliver stock once.
Success instructions mention right-clicking the chest or its attached sign.
Full clean restart, unavailable Economy service and absent Vault retain stock protection.
limitations: Human mouse-pointer position, client packets, real Java/Bedrock rendering and phone layout were not tested.
Actual economy, GriefPrevention, Geyser/Floodgate, real player persistence and other-plugin interactions were not tested.
The legacy migration suite is supported but was not rerun for this UI-only candidate; prior migration evidence is historical.
